title: ENGRAM: From Agent Experience to Weights through Verified Consolidation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents use experience through external retrieval and parameter learning. Consolidating stored experience into model weights requires deciding both which experience to train on and when its external records can leave retrieval. Admission based solely on student mastery can exclude useful teacher demonstrations, while removal immediately after training can discard guidance that the model still needs. We introduce ENGRAM, a framework that separates training admission from memory release. A demonstration-aware gate admits skills based on student mastery or sufficient successful teacher demonstrations. The student learns from selected action traces with context from an Engram Trace Graph (ETG). A verification gate then compares the updated model without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval on reserved probes. translated_title: ENGRAM：通过验证式巩固将智能体经验融入模型权重
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体通过外部检索和参数学习来利用经验。将存储的经验巩固到模型权重中，既需要决定训练哪些经验，又需要决定何时其外部记录可以从检索中移除。仅基于学生模型掌握程度的准入可能会排除有用的教师示范，而训练后立即移除可能会丢弃模型仍然需要的指导。我们提出了ENGRAM，一个将训练准入与记忆释放相分离的框架。一个感知示范的门控基于学生掌握程度或足够多的成功教师示范来准入技能。学生模型从选定的动作轨迹中学习，并结合来自“印迹轨迹图”的上下文。随后，一个验证门控在保留的探针任务上，将不使用情节检索的更新后模型与使用检索的基础模型进行比较。记忆的释放要求经验参与了有效训练，并且得分同时满足相对和绝对标准。
tldr: ENGRAM框架将训练准入与记忆释放分离，通过示范感知门控、印迹轨迹图上下文学习和验证门控，只有当经验被有效训练且更新后的模型在无需检索的情况下仍达到相对和绝对评分标准时，才将外部记忆释放移除。
en_tdlr: ENGRAM separates training admission from memory release, using a demonstration-aware gate, ETG-based contextual learning, and a verification gate so that memories are only removed from retrieval after valid training and when the updated model meets both relative and absolute score criteria without episodic retrieval.
